params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} {{cis|Brand}} {{tip|abilities}} apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Ablaze'' to enemies hit. Subsequent abilities used against a target with ''Ablaze'' are empowered. Killing an enemy afflicted with ''Ablaze'' or with an ability restores {{as|{{sti|mana}}}}.
params.blurb2: At three stacks, {{tip|champion|champions}} and large {{tip|monsters}} become unstable and explode after a brief delay, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and applying a stack of ''Ablaze''. ''Ablaze'' cannot stack more than once on enemies who have recently exploded.
params.blurb4: {{sbc|Ablaze:}} While afflicted with ''Ablaze'', the target is continually dealt {{as|magic damage}} equal to a portion of {{as|their '''maximum''' health}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Brand's''' {{tip|abilities}} apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Ablaze'' to enemies hit for 4 seconds, stacking up to 3 times and refreshing the duration of all stacks with each application. Subsequent abilities used against a target with ''Ablaze'' are empowered. Killing an enemy afflicted with ''Ablaze'' or any enemy with an ability restores {{as|{{pp|20 to 40 for 5|1;6 to 15|changedisplay=true|formula=20 at level 1, then +5 every 3 levels starting at level 6 and capped at level 15}} {{sti|mana}}}}.
params.description2: {{sbc|Ablaze:}} While afflicted with ''Ablaze'', the target is dealt {{as|magic damage}} equal to{{ft|{{as|2% of their '''maximum''' health}} over 4 seconds.|{{as|{{ap|2/12|round=3}}% of their '''maximum''' health}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds over 4 seconds.}}Each stack of ''Ablaze'' deals damage to the target individually and applies their damage ticks dependent on the time they were applied, even if the duration of all the stacks are refreshed. ''Ablaze'' deals 270% damage per tick to {{tip|monsters}}; this damage is capped at{{ft|{{pp|50/4 to (50/4)*3|1;2;3|type=''Ablaze'' stacks}} per tick against non-epic monsters and {{pp|80/4 to (80/4)*3|1;2;3|type=''Ablaze'' stacks}} per tick against epic monsters.|a total of {{pp|50*4 to 50*4*3|1;2;3|type=''Ablaze'' stacks}} against non-epic monsters and {{pp|80*4 to 80*4*3|1;2;3|type=''Ablaze'' stacks}} against epic monsters.}}
params.description3: Upon applying 3 stacks of ''Ablaze'' to a large {{tip|monster}} or enemy {{tip|champion}}, the fire becomes unstable, causing it to form a fiery ring around the target that grants {{tip|sight}} within its radius and, after 2 seconds, consumes their stacks to explode. All enemies within the detonation are applied a stack of ''Ablaze'' and dealt {{as|magic damage}} equal to {{as|{{pplevel|6 to 12|key=%}} {{as|(+ 2% per 100 AP)}} of their '''maximum''' health}}, capped at {{pp|270 to 525|1;6;11;16}} against {{tip|monsters}}.
params.description4: '''Brand''' cannot stack ''Ablaze'' more than once on enemies that have had a ring explode from them in the last 4 seconds.
params.description5: ''The ring will form even if the target dies to the ability applying the third stack, and will still trigger the explosion if the target dies before it.''
params.notes:
* The burn deals {{tip|persistent damage}}, and the explosion deals {{tip|area damage}}; both are additionally tagged as {{tip|indirect damage}}.
* ''Ablaze'' is a {{tip|debuff}} that persists through {{tip|death}}.
* ''Ablaze's'' damage cap against a {{tip|monster}} is applied after the increased monster damage.
* The explosion is not considered a {{tip|tether}} effect and will not affect {{tip|untargetable}} targets, even if the explosion originated from them.
* Given the behavior of the stacking mechanic, the damage over time will deal varying amounts of damage based on the time the stacks were applied:
** At sub-optimal applied times, 2 stacks will deal a minimum of {{as|6% '''maximum''' health}} damage over 4 seconds, but will deal {{as|7% '''maximum''' health}} at optimal applied times.
** Against small-medium units 3 stacks will deal a minimum of {{as|9% '''maximum''' health}} at sub-optimal times, but {{as|11% '''maximum''' health}} at optimal times. If these stacks are further {{tt|refreshed|By ablazing a target that's already at 3 stacks}} at optimal times they can deal up to {{as|12% '''maximum''' health}} over 4 seconds.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Brand}} launches a fireball in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|{{ai|Blaze|Brand|Ablaze}} Bonus:}} An ''Ablaze'' target hit will also be briefly {{tip|stun|stunned}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Brand''' launches a fireball in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit.
params.description2: {{sbc|{{ai|Blaze|Brand|Ablaze}} Bonus:}} The target is {{tip|stun|stunned}} for {{fd|1.75}} seconds.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} After a brief delay, {{ci|Brand}} erupts a pillar of flame at the target location that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|{{ai|Blaze|Brand|Ablaze}} Bonus:}} An ''Ablaze'' target hit will take bonus damage.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} After a {{rutngt|0.625}} delay, '''Brand''' erupts a pillar of flame at the target location that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit.
params.description2: {{sbc|{{ai|Blaze|Brand|Ablaze}} Bonus:}} The target takes 25% increased damage.
params.notes: * The delay before the eruption does not include the cast time. The delay would be a total of {{rutngt|0.889}} if it included the cast time.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Brand}} sets the target enemy aflame, which creates a blast that deals {{as|magic damage}} to them and nearby enemies.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|{{ai|Blaze|Brand|Ablaze}} Bonus:}} The blast spreads twice as far on an ''Ablaze'' target.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Brand''' sets the target enemy aflame, which creates a blast that deals {{as|magic damage}} to them and causes the flame to spread from the target to nearby enemies, dealing them the same damage.
params.effect radius: {{dv|{{tip|cr|icononly=true}} {{tt|300|Secondary target spread radius}}|{{tt|600|Secondary target spread radius if primary target was Ablaze}}}}

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Brand}} unleashes a devastating torrent of fire that bounces to nearby enemies, dealing {{as|magic damage}} each time it bounces.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|{{ai|Blaze|Brand|Ablaze}} Bonus:}} An ''Ablaze'' target will also be briefly {{tip|slow|slowed}} when hit.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Brand''' launches a fireball at the target enemy that bounces between nearby enemies and '''Brand''' up to four times, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies each time and having a {{fd|0.15}}-second delay between bounces.
params.leveling: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|100 to 250}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}}|Total Single-Target Damage|{{ap|100*3 to 250*3}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30*3}}% AP)}}}}
params.description2: ''Pyroclasm'' prioritizes ''{{ai|Blaze|Brand|Ablaze}}'' enemy champions, then other enemy champions, then any valid bounce target, then '''Brand'''.
params.description3: {{sbc|{{ai|Blaze|Brand|Ablaze}} Bonus:}} The target is {{tip|slow|slowed}} for {{fd|0.25}} seconds. This can affect the same enemy more than once.
params.description4: ''The target does not have to be {{tip|sight|visible}} for the fireball to bounce to them.''
params.effect radius: {{tip|cr|icononly=true}} {{tt|600|Bounce range, checked when fireball arrives at a target}}
params.notes:
* The fireball acquires a new valid, bounce target once the bounce delay finishes.
* If the target the fireball is in flight towards becomes {{tip|untargetable}}, the fireball missile will be destroyed but a new missile will be formed at the target's location that is able to bounce for up to the remaining bounces of the previous fireball.
** The new missile is only formed if there is a valid target to bounce to at the time of the previous missile being destroyed.
** This does not apply if the target is '''Brand''', as the missile would not be destroyed and would bounce from him even if he is untargetable.
* The fireball will still bounce from the target even if they were dead upon arrival.
* The fireball may only bounce to valid targets, including '''Brand'''.
* If the initial cast target uses {{tip|spell shield}}, ''Pyroclasm'' will not bounce. If the bounce is blocked by an enemy's ''spell shield'' it will not deal any damage, but it will keep on bouncing.
* ''Pyroclasm's'' damage against enemy champions will not aggro nearby enemy minions.{{bug}}
